intentHeading: What would you like to do first?
intentHint: This only decides where the guide takes you. Everything else in Flint stays available.

question.title: Ask a question
question.description: Chat with a model about anything.

documents.title: Work with documents
documents.description: Attach files and ask about them.

project.title: Build or change a project
project.description: Let Flint work in a folder on this computer, asking before it changes anything.

resumeNotice: Welcome back. You can continue where you left off.
processingLocal: A local model runs on this computer. Your messages and files stay here, and no account or API key is needed.
processingRemote: A remote provider (for example OpenAI) runs the model on its servers. Your messages and any files you include are sent there, and the provider may charge you. You set this up yourself in Settings; Flint never switches to one on its own.

guideTitle.question: Getting started: ask a question
guideTitle.project: Getting started: build or change a project

choose-model.title: Choose or connect a model
choose-model.body: Pick a model with the selector at the top. Local models run on this computer; remote providers need their own account.

add-material.documents: Attach a document with the paperclip button in the message box.
add-material.project: Open Cowork and choose your project's folder. Flint asks before it edits files or runs commands.

first-task.title: Send your first message
first-task.body: Ask something, or describe the change you want. This step completes when a conversation starts.

review-context.title: Check what Flint used
review-context.body: After Flint answers, open "What Flint is using" in the conversation to see which attachments and instructions were available to it.

guideComplete: You're set up. Reopen this guide any time from Settings > General.
reopenGuideDescription: Walk through choosing a model, adding material and completing a first task again.
